title: Anomalous properties of 2D active scalars perturbed by rough transport noise
summary: We study SPDEs associated with $2$D active scalars driven by incompressible transport noise of Kraichnan type, with regularity exponent $α\in (0,1)$; our examples include the Euler, SQG and IPM systems. We investigate whether a number of ``turbulent'' phenomenologies, which are well understood in the linear Kraichnan model, persist in this nonlinear setting, uniformly in vanishing viscosity approximations.
